series_end_reason: Spark was acquired by Roche on 2019-12-17 and deregistered; no 10-K for 2019 exists. Roche prints no quarterly Luxturna sales (half-year level only, in CHF).
search_log: Listed every Spark filing (CIK 0001609351, all forms) via data.sec.gov/submissions; 'Product sales, net' read from the 10-Q statements of operations 2018Q1-2019Q3 (scripts/spark.py); Spark's 2019 earnings releases were not issued after the Roche merger agreement (last release 2019-02-19 for FY2018), so 2019 quarters are cited to the 10-Qs. Luxturna first sales 2018Q1 (2,419 thousand vs nil).
Q4 2018 derived as the 10-K full year less nine months (neither release nor 10-K prints a Q4 column).

Spark was acquired by Roche on 2019-12-17 (8-K items 2.01/5.01, Form 15-12B 2019-12-27); no 10-K for 2019 exists, so 2019Q4 is not reported. Roche (not an SEC filer for these documents; roche.com) does not print quarterly Luxturna sales: its Half-Year Report 2023 states only 'Interim sales of Luxturna for 2022 were CHF 12 million' (half-year level, CHF), so no later series is cited and nothing is interpolated.
